title: Atom-diff CLI: post-migration atom set is ⊇ matrix-intended (no widening)
preconds: Test tenant on the pre-migration build. CRP-BE-08 atom-diff CLI script is available.
steps:
1. Run the atom-diff CLI in pre-migration mode. Capture the per-role atom set output.
2. Run the migration on the test tenant.
3. Run the atom-diff CLI in post-migration mode.
4. For each of the 11 system roles, diff pre vs post.
5. For each role, compare the post-migration atom set against the tech plan §3c matrix row's intended capability set.
6. Fail if any role's post-migration set is WIDER than the matrix-intended set (over-grant) or NARROWER than expected for a role that should preserve a legacy capability.
expected: Atom-diff CLI completes with exit 0. No role's post-migration set is wider than the matrix-intended set. The CLI's output is captured as a release-gate artifact.
